scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,admin,pwa -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w admin" "npm run dev -w pwa"
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:setup -w backend
scripts.build: npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w admin && npm run build -w pwa
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w admin && npm run lint -w pwa
